items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I heard a lot of talk of Joe Oliver. I mean, being young, I just remember, you know.

ctx.x: Manuel Perez. Joe, wasn't Joe? Joe Nicklaus.
Did you hear Joe Oliver when you were a kid?
I heard a lot of talk of Joe Oliver. I mean, being young, I just remember, you know.
